news.fullContent:
Announcement from United Youth Forum of Science and Research (UYFSR):

We are excited to unveil the official structure for our 3-day flagship festival — National Science Eclipse 2026, taking place from 16 to 18 April 2026.

Students from schools, colleges, and polytechnic institutes will compete across 14 scientific categories. Major highlights include the Future Idea Showcase, working hardware project displays, and theoretical problem-solving olympiads.

Online team registrations and student delegate enrolments are now officially open on our web portal.

news.title: Campus Ambassador Recruitment: Cohort 2026
news.excerpt: UYFSR is actively seeking passionate student ambassadors across secondary schools, higher secondary colleges, and universities to lead scientific culture and research initiatives on their campus.
news.fullContent:
Official Call for Campus Ambassadors — Cohort 2026:

Do you want to represent the United Youth Forum of Science and Research (UYFSR) at your institution? We are now recruiting dedicated student representatives nationwide!

As a Campus Ambassador, you will:
• Lead science clubs and workshop delegations at your institution
• Receive an official Appointment Letter & verified digital E-Pass
• Gain priority invitations to national fairs, awards, and secretarial symposia
• Earn verified leadership credentials and letters of recommendation

Apply now through the registration portal or email us at uyfsr.org@gmail.com.

hero.headline: Science, research, and reform by youth.
hero.leadText: Welcome to the official page of UYFSR — United Youth Forum of Science and Research, established 30 May 2025. Where young minds unite to ignite change through science and reform. We turn ideas into action, dreams into movements, and passion into progress. Join us in shaping a smarter, stronger, and sustainable tomorrow.

missionVision.missionText: The mission of United Youth Forum of Science and Research (UYFSR) is to introduce and promote the culture of research among students and young individuals. We believe that research is not limited to scientists or higher-level academics; it is a field of exploration that everyone should have the opportunity to understand and experience. Our aim is to inspire students to think beyond textbooks, ask questions, explore new ideas, and develop a deeper understanding of the world through scientific thinking and research.
missionVision.visionText: Our vision is to build a generation that is curious, creative, knowledgeable, and passionate about research and scientific exploration. We aspire to make research more accessible and familiar to students and people from different backgrounds, encouraging them to explore new possibilities, challenge existing ideas, and contribute to the advancement of knowledge.

faqs.q: What is the United Youth Forum of Science and Research (UYFSR)?
faqs.a: United Youth Forum of Science and Research (UYFSR) is an educational and research-oriented organization established on 30 May 2025. Our mission is to promote science, research, innovation, and scientific awareness among young minds, turning curiosity into meaningful knowledge and impactful action.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to participate in UYFSR programs and workshops?
faqs.a: Our programs are open to school, college, and undergraduate students, as well as young independent researchers. We design our competitions, Olympiads, and seminars, including the National Science Eclipse and Junior Talent Awards, to welcome students at all stages of their academic journey.

faqs.q: How does UYFSR make scientific research accessible to students?
faqs.a: We believe research is not limited to senior institutional professors. We guide students to think beyond textbooks, formulate original questions, and learn practical methodology through hands-on seminars, peer collaboration, and project showcases.

faqs.q: What are the flagship upcoming events scheduled for 2026?
faqs.a: Key upcoming events include the National Science Eclipse 2026 (16–18 April 2026), KIDLON Presents Junior Talent Award: Season 1 (18 July 2026), and the Junior Startup Challenge: Season 1 (3 September 2026).

faqs.q: How can institutions and youth clubs partner with UYFSR?
faqs.a: We actively collaborate with educational institutions, campus media clubs, and partner organizations as co-organizers, workshop partners, and venue hosts, working alongside partners like TWIMBOL, KIDLON, MEJOLOGY, and Adamjee School Communication Club.
